en.headline: Motorcyclist, 21, dies after crash on Tai Au Mun Road
en.dek: The rider lost control on a left bend near Clear Water Bay First Beach just after midnight and struck a stone barrier; he was certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital.
body: A 21-year-old motorcyclist died after crashing into a stone barrier on Tai Au Mun Road in Clear Water Bay in the early hours of Wednesday, police and local reports said.

The crash happened at about 12.44am as the motorcycle was travelling towards Kowloon. On a left bend near Clear Water Bay First Beach the rider lost control and hit the barrier on the left. The motorcycle travelled about another 15 metres before stopping. The rider was found lying on the road unconscious and was taken to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he later died.

The motorcycle was badly damaged, with parts including the fuel tank scattered on the road. A helmet was also found at the scene. Tai Au Mun Road was temporarily closed in both directions while officers worked.
Police are investigating the cause of the crash. The rider has not been named.

zh.headline: 清水灣大坳門路電單車撞石壘 21歲鐵騎士不治
zh.dek: 凌晨近1時電單車在清水灣第一灣對開左彎失控，騎士昏迷送將軍澳醫院後不治，警方正調查起因。
body: 一名21歲電單車司機周三凌晨在清水灣大坳門路撞向石壘，送院後不治。
事發約凌晨12晈44分，電單車沿大坳門路往九龍方向行駛，途經清水灣第一灣對開左彎時失控，撞向左側石壘，再滑行約15米才停下。騎士倒臥路上昏迷，由救護車送往將軍澳醫院，其後不治。
電單車嚴重損毀，油缸等零件散落路面，現場亦發現頭盔。大坳門路一度雙向封閉，以便調查。
警方正調查意外原因。死者姓名未有公布。
